title: byte equality, ordering, and explicit int conversion for indexing and ranges
purpose: Observe the values produced by the operation.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.4: byte orders with byte; language owner decision, 21.10.2026 (D-046): different numeric categories interact only after an explicit cast; no implicit promotion: a byte index or range bound is converted with .int() (elements are int), byte*float needs float(...), giving 2.5.
